gloss: all the more; even more; especially

definitions.gloss: all the more; even more; still more
definitions.explanation: Indicates that something intensifies a situation or makes it even more applicable. Used when one condition makes another condition even stronger.

examples.japanese: {雨|あめ}の{日|ひ}は{尚更|なおさら}{外|そと}に{出|で}たくない。
examples.english: On rainy days, I want to go out even less.

examples.japanese: {病気|びょうき}の{時|とき}は{尚更|なおさら}{栄養|えいよう}を{取|と}らなければならない。
examples.english: When you're sick, you need to get nutrition all the more.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}が{反対|はんたい}すると、{彼女|かのじょ}は{尚更|なおさら}やりたくなる。
examples.english: The more he opposes it, the more she wants to do it.

notes:
USAGE:
{尚更|なおさら} expresses "even more so" when a condition intensifies another situation.
・AならBは{尚更|なおさら}だ (If A, then B is even more so)
・{尚更|なおさら}〜ない (even less likely to ~)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{尚更|なおさら}のこと (all the more reason; especially)
・ましてや〜は{尚更|なおさら}だ (let alone ~; ~ is even more so)

EXAMPLE STRUCTURE:
「AでもBだ。Cなら{尚更|なおさら}だ。」
(If A, then B. If C, then even more so.)

WRITING NOTE:
Often written in hiragana as なおさら in casual contexts. The kanji {尚更|なおさら} is more formal.

RELATED WORDS:
・ますます (increasingly, more and more)
・いっそう (even more, still more)
・{一層|いっそう} (all the more - more formal)
